name: B52 Victory Museum
descriptionEn: Dedicated to the military history of Vietnam, showcasing the debris of US B-52 bombers shot down during the Christmas bombings of 1972.

name: Bach Ma Temple
descriptionEn: Located in Hanoi's Old Quarter, this is the city's oldest temple, built in the 9th century and dedicated to the White Horse guardian spirit.

name: Ba Dinh Square
descriptionEn: The historic square where President Ho Chi Minh read the Declaration of Independence in 1945, now home to the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum.

name: Bat Trang Ceramic Village
descriptionEn: A traditional pottery village on the outskirts of Hanoi, famous for its high-quality ceramic artwork and hands-on clay workshops.

name: Ca Tru Thang Long
descriptionEn: A traditional chamber music performance club dedicated to preserving Ca Tru, an ancient Vietnamese musical storytelling form recognized by UNESCO.

name: Cau The Huc
descriptionEn: The iconic red-painted wooden bridge across Hoan Kiem Lake, connecting the lakeshore to the historic Ngoc Son Temple.

name: Chua Tran Quoc
descriptionEn: The oldest Buddhist pagoda in Hanoi, standing on a small island in West Lake with a history dating back over 1,500 years.

name: Dinh Le Book Street
descriptionEn: A popular pedestrian street near Hoan Kiem Lake, lined with bookshops and outdoor book stalls, a quiet haven for readers.

name: Dinh Q. Le Gallery
descriptionEn: A contemporary art space featuring works of local and international artists, exploring history, memory, and cultural identity.

name: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square
descriptionEn: A bustling public square at the northern end of Hoan Kiem Lake, serving as a major hub for weekend street performances and city gatherings.

name: Dong Xuan Market
descriptionEn: Hanoi's largest indoor market, offering wholesale and retail goods, local street food, and a vibrant peak into local trading habits.

name: Fine Arts Museum (Bao Tang My Thuat)
descriptionEn: Showcases Vietnam's artistic legacy from ancient stone carvings and religious sculptures to modern paintings, woodcuts, and lacquer art.

name: GOm Show
descriptionEn: An interactive cultural and theatrical performance highlighting traditional Vietnamese arts, folk music, and legendary stories.

name: Ham Long Church
descriptionEn: A beautiful historic Roman Catholic church built in the early 20th century, known for its elegant French colonial architecture and tall bell tower.

name: Hang Bac Street
descriptionEn: One of the oldest streets in Hanoi's Old Quarter, historically famous for silver-smithing, jewelry making, and traditional merchant houses.

name: Hang Dau Street
descriptionEn: A lively historical street in the Old Quarter, famous for shoe merchants and its proximity to the historic Hang Dau Water Tower.

name: Hang Gai Silk Street
descriptionEn: The premier shopping street in Hanoi for high-quality silk products, custom tailoring, and traditional Vietnamese crafts.

name: Hang Ma Street
descriptionEn: A colorful Old Quarter street known for selling paper offerings, festival decorations, lanterns, and traditional toys throughout the year.

name: Hanoi Ceramic Mosaic Mural
descriptionEn: A massive, colorful ceramic mosaic running along the Red River dike road, built to celebrate the Hanoi Millennium in 2010.

name: Hanoi Creative City
descriptionEn: An arts and culture hub housed in a repurposed building, featuring cafes, art galleries, and creative workshops for local youth.

name: Hanoi Flag Tower
descriptionEn: One of the symbols of the city, this historic stone tower stands in the Military History Museum complex, built in 1812.

name: Hanoi Old Citadel - Northern Gate
descriptionEn: The historic northern gate of the Thang Long Imperial Citadel, showing cannon fire scars from the French invasions in the 19th century.

name: Hanoi Old Quarter Vietnam
descriptionEn: The historical heart of the city, characterized by narrow streets named after traditional crafts, old merchant homes, and vibrant street life.

name: Hanoi Opera House
descriptionEn: A magnificent neoclassical opera house built by the French administration between 1901 and 1911, serving as a cultural landmark.

name: Hanoi Police Museum
descriptionEn: Displays historic artifacts, uniforms, and documents detailing the history, development, and operations of the Hanoi police force.

name: Hanoi Train Street
descriptionEn: A famous narrow residential street where trains pass just inches from local cafes and doorsteps, an iconic photo spot for visitors.

name: Hanoi Zoo (Thu Le Zoo)
descriptionEn: A peaceful city park and zoo located around Thu Le Lake, offering a green escape and family-friendly walking paths.

name: Heritage Space
descriptionEn: An independent art space hosting contemporary art exhibitions, music concerts, library discussions, and creative workshops.

name: Hoa Lo Prison
descriptionEn: Originally built by French colonists to hold political prisoners, later used for American POWs, now a moving historical museum.

name: Hoang Hoa Tham Flower Street
descriptionEn: A bustling green street famous for plant nurseries, florist shops, ornamental trees, and street vendors selling seasonal flowers.

name: Hoan Kiem Lake
descriptionEn: The peaceful heart of Hanoi, surrounded by walking paths, home to the Tortoise Tower and linked to the legend of the restored sword.

name: Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum
descriptionEn: The grand marble monument housing the embalmed body of President Ho Chi Minh, located in the historic Ba Dinh Square.

name: Ho Chi Minh Museum
descriptionEn: Designed in the shape of a white lotus, this museum is dedicated to the life, revolutionary struggle, and global legacy of Ho Chi Minh.

name: Ho Chi Minh's Stilt House
descriptionEn: The simple wooden stilt house where President Ho Chi Minh lived and worked from 1958 until his death in 1969, set in a tranquil garden.

name: Huu Tiep Lake (B52 Lake)
descriptionEn: A quiet neighborhood lake in Ngoc Ha flower village, containing the rusted wreckage of a shot-down B-52 bomber from 1972.

name: Imperial Citadel of Thang Long
descriptionEn: A UNESCO World Heritage site, serving as the political center of Vietnam for 13 consecutive centuries, featuring ancient foundations and relics.

name: Kim Lien Pagoda
descriptionEn: An ancient Buddhist pagoda built on a peninsula in West Lake, famous for its elegant wood carvings and peaceful lakeside atmosphere.

name: Lenin Park
descriptionEn: A public park in Ba Dinh district, featuring a bronze statue of Vladimir Lenin, popular for local exercise and skateboarding.

name: Long Bien Bridge
descriptionEn: A historic cantilever bridge across the Red River, designed by Eiffel's company, serving as a symbol of Hanoi's resilience.

name: Ly Thai To Park
descriptionEn: A lakeside public square featuring a large bronze statue of King Ly Thai To, the founder of Hanoi (Thang Long) in 1010 AD.

name: Ma May Ancient House
descriptionEn: A beautifully restored traditional tube house in the Old Quarter, showing the lifestyle and architecture of 19th-century merchants.

name: Nghia Do Park
descriptionEn: A popular family park in Cau Giay district, featuring vast green lawns, walking paths, play areas, and a central lake.

name: Ngoc Khanh Lake
descriptionEn: A scenic neighborhood lake surrounded by walking paths, cafes, and shops, popular for evening strolls.

name: Ngoc Son Temple
descriptionEn: A scenic temple situated on Jade Island in Hoan Kiem Lake, dedicated to General Tran Hung Dao and scholar Van Xuong.

name: Night Market
descriptionEn: A weekend pedestrian market stretching through the Old Quarter, filled with food stalls, clothing, and local souvenirs.

name: Old Quarter
descriptionEn: Hanoi's historic center, featuring 36 streets of traditional craft guilds, architectural styles, and vibrant street culture.

name: One Pillar Pagoda
descriptionEn: An iconic historic Buddhist temple built on a single stone pillar in the middle of a lotus pond, dating back to 1049 AD.

name: Phan Dinh Phung Street
descriptionEn: One of Hanoi's most beautiful tree-lined boulevards, famous for its French colonial villas and yellow leaves in autumn.

name: Phu Tay Ho
descriptionEn: A highly revered spiritual temple on a peninsula in West Lake, dedicated to the Mother Goddess Lieu Hanh.

name: Quan Su Pagoda
descriptionEn: The headquarters of the Vietnam Buddhist Sangha, a beautiful historic temple serving as a center for Buddhist activities.

name: Quan Thanh Temple
descriptionEn: An 11th-century Taoist temple near West Lake, dedicated to Huyen Thien Tran Vu, one of the four guardian gods of ancient Hanoi.

name: Salon Natasha
descriptionEn: Hanoi's first private art gallery opened after Doi Moi, a historic meeting place for contemporary artists in the 1990s.

name: St. Joseph's Cathedral
descriptionEn: A grand 19th-century Gothic Revival church resembling Notre Dame de Paris, a focal point for Hanoi's Christian community.

name: Ta Hien Street
descriptionEn: The famous 'beer street' in the Old Quarter, packed with international travelers, local youth, street food, and nightlife.

name: Tay Ho Promenade
descriptionEn: A scenic walking path along the banks of West Lake, lined with restaurants, cafes, and beautiful sunset views.

name: Temple of Literature
descriptionEn: Vietnam's first national university, built in 1070 AD, dedicated to Confucius and showcasing historic stone steles of scholars.

name: Thang Long Water Puppet Theater
descriptionEn: The premier venue for water puppetry, a traditional art form originating in the flooded rice paddies of northern Vietnam.

name: Thap Rua Tower
descriptionEn: The iconic Tortoise Tower standing on a small island in Hoan Kiem Lake, a symbol of Hanoi's history and mythology.

name: Thien Quang Lake
descriptionEn: A peaceful park lake surrounded by old trees, providing a green breathing space near the southern edge of the Old Quarter.

name: Thong Nhat Park
descriptionEn: Hanoi's largest public park, featuring Bay Mau Lake, walking paths, gardens, and a tranquil escape from urban noise.

name: Truc Bach Lake
descriptionEn: A scenic lake separated from West Lake by Thanh Nien Road, famous for swan pedal boats, cafes, and historical monuments.

name: Van Phuc Silk Village
descriptionEn: A traditional silk-weaving village on the edge of Hanoi, renowned for producing exquisite high-grade silk products.

name: VICAS Art Studio
descriptionEn: A contemporary art gallery and creative space managed by the Vietnam Institute of Culture and Arts Studies.

name: Vietnamese Women's Museum
descriptionEn: A highly-rated museum highlighting the roles, history, and contributions of women in Vietnamese family, war, and society.

name: Vietnam Military History Museum
descriptionEn: Displays historic tanks, fighter aircraft, weaponry, and exhibits detailing Vietnam's military struggle for independence.

name: Vietnam Museum of Ethnology
descriptionEn: A fascinating museum showcasing the cultures, lifestyles, houses, and traditional clothing of Vietnam's 54 ethnic groups.

name: Vietnam Museum of Fine Arts
descriptionEn: The country's premier art museum, displaying historical artifacts, Buddhist sculptures, lacquer paintings, and modern arts.

name: Vietnam National Museum of History
descriptionEn: Houses a rich collection of archaeological artifacts tracing the history of Vietnam from prehistory to the mid-20th century.

name: Vietnam National Tuong Theatre
descriptionEn: A performance center dedicated to Tuong, a classical Vietnamese opera form known for elaborate makeup and singing.

name: West Lake
descriptionEn: Hanoi's largest freshwater lake, surrounded by historic temples, luxury hotels, upscale dining, and popular walking paths.

name: Work Room Four
descriptionEn: A contemporary design studio, art gallery, and creative workshop space supporting local and international artists in Hanoi.
